name: ray_click
description: Template: click a panel button THROUGH the controller ray (not by invoking its handler), and prove it with state before and after. The app needs <prefix>_ui_point {name} -> {position, normal} and <prefix>_get_input_state -> {left|right: {rayOrigin, rayDirection, hovered, onUi}}. If this fails while <prefix>_click_widget succeeds, the bug is in the aim, the raycast or the event path, not the handler.

steps.symptom: (setup) the Settings window does not open
the right controller's ray cannot be brought onto the Apply button
pulling the trigger with the ray on Apply does nothing
